result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **Bitwarden Teams** for the best balance of security, features, and price. If ease of use and a polished experience matter more than cost, **1Password** is my runner-up.

Here are the options I'd seriously consider.

## Best password managers for small teams

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best overall value)

# \$4

Per user/month, billed annually

- Shared password collections
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Directory sync and SCIM
- Open-source foundations
- Good cross-platform support

Best for teams that want strong security without spending much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![1Password for Digital Nomads: Complete Security Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/k9DPlG2oS1kAhY0t1_mWUfr6qVPrSb5JIP9_lU7zt66pw8_MhH9QnISQTKX6UoTZKSVJemNfMrNMhx-5rTHwvq3YUGcLopCG__Wn0zxsoSbEbg42YLs6wO1_hm5hzP1p61GhjqvoPKdJFecQjX0MKC0SHD_tHrHovoKUe8ipelZ3tzfEXDI35ydWKKdW1H1i?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. 1Password**

(Best user experience)

# \$8.99

Per user/month, Business plan, annually

- Excellent desktop and mobile apps
- Intuitive shared vaults
- Granular permissions
- Strong admin and reporting tools
- Great onboarding experience

Best for teams that want something employees will actually enjoy using.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Security**

# \$2

Per user/month, Business Starter, annually

- Centralized administration
- Secure shared folders
- Strong security and compliance options
- Additional enterprise security features

Best for smaller teams on a tight budget.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

# \$8

Per user/month, annually

- Password health monitoring
- Admin console
- Security alerts
- Business integrations

Best for teams wanting additional password security monitoring.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are published 2026 starting prices and may vary by plan, billing term and region. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall value | Bitwarden |
| Easiest for employees | 1Password |
| Lowest entry price | Keeper |
| Security monitoring | Dashlane |


For a typical 5–20-person company, I'd narrow it down to Bitwarden and 1Password.

## A few questions to narrow it down

I can give you a much more specific recommendation with three details\:

1. **How many people?** 2–5, 5–10, 10–25, or 25–50?
2. **What do you use?** Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or something else?
3. **What's most important?** Lowest cost, easiest experience, or strongest security and admin controls?

The biggest thing I'd look for is the ability to share passwords securely, control who can access them, and immediately revoke access when someone leaves the company.
